films.title: Our Hospitality
films.overview: A young man falls for a young woman on his trip home; unbeknownst to him, her family has vowed to kill every member of his family.

films.title: Block-Heads
films.overview: It's 1938, but Stan doesn't know the war is over; he's still patrolling the trenches in France, and shoots down a French aviator. Oliver sees his old chum's picture in the paper and goes to visit Stan who has now been returned to the States and invites him back to his home.

films.title: Swiss Miss
films.overview: Stan and Ollie are mousetrap salesmen hoping for better business in Switzerland, with Stan's theory that because there is more cheese in Switzerland, there should be more mice.
